title: Confirm course requirements and freeze scope
outcome: Record the official course constraints and agree on a modest, testable project.
acceptance: Complete the course-site checklist in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md, including the exact deadline cutoff.
Confirm the research question, core deliverables, and optional features.
Record decisions and unresolved questions in docs/DECISIONS.md.

title: Confirm TC2 access and record the compute budget
outcome: Establish the hardware and scheduling limits before promising training runs.
acceptance: Check the coursework GPU application and record allocation status.
Record GPU/VRAM, job duration, storage, and software constraints in docs/COMPUTE.md.
Define a profiling plan and fallback if allocation remains pending.

title: Create a reproducible development environment
outcome: Make the CPU development environment reproducible, then document the GPU setup as access becomes available.
acceptance: Add a dependency manifest and tested setup instructions with exact versions.
Add an environment/device check; verify CPU setup without waiting for T02 and record GPU checks as pending until hardware is available.
Select artifact locations and a configuration format; keep credentials out of Git.
Document working commands as modules are implemented; mark unavailable commands clearly.

title: Freeze simulator, action, and dataset interfaces
outcome: Let simulator, model, and evaluation work proceed against one agreed contract.
acceptance: Finalize units, axis conventions, force duration, friction law, frame timing, and collision event semantics.
Finalize tensor shapes, timestamps, scene replay metadata, object identity/padding, and conditioning inputs in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Define scene_group_id and condition_id, including identical-first-frame uncertainty groups.
Provide a small fixture or schema example that downstream components can consume.

title: Implement the seeded 64px tabletop simulator
outcome: Generate repeatable tabletop clips with usable physical labels.
acceptance: Render 2-4 objects with randomized supported shapes/textures, mass, and friction.
Apply the agreed centre force and export positions, masks, object collisions, and wall contacts.
Verify deterministic replay, zero-force behavior, force reversal, and a known collision case.
Replay a saved scene using its specification, config, assets, physics, and action; provide a documented generation/replay command and tolerance.

title: Build versioned datasets and leakage-safe splits
outcome: Produce a traceable dataset with independent visible-scene groups and controlled OOD tests.
acceptance: Export a smoke dataset, measure generation cost/storage, and propose the main dataset size.
Split by scene_group_id; keep all actions and physics variants of a visible scene together.
Create train, validation, ID-test, shape-OOD, texture-OOD, force-OOD, and repeated-hidden-physics test manifests with disjoint scene groups.
Check identical initial inputs within condition_id and independence of hidden physics from appearance.
Publish dataset/schema versions, split hashes, and download or generation instructions.

title: Implement and validate the evaluation pipeline
outcome: Measure generated video behavior consistently across models.
acceptance: Implement ADE/FDE, action-direction and zero-force controls, interval collision accuracy, event precision/recall/F1, and image/temporal/diversity metrics.
Validate the object tracker and contact estimator on held-out simulator clips; record extraction failures.
Test metrics on exact, shifted, static, and corrupted controls with expected outcomes.
Separate video-derived metrics from auxiliary-head metrics and export machine-readable records.
Define whole-sample best-of-K selection, metric preprocessing, missing-track handling, and collision-aware temporal checks before evaluating models.

title: Train and validate the shared frame autoencoder
outcome: Obtain a compact latent representation that preserves object geometry.
acceptance: Implement or select a permitted autoencoder and record architecture/weight provenance.
Fit weights and normalization on training data only; select the checkpoint on validation data and inspect test/OOD reconstruction only after freezing it.
Record memory, throughput, latent shapes, and a checkpoint with checksum.
Freeze and share the selected autoencoder across diffusion comparisons.

title: Train the conditional VAE baseline E0
outcome: Establish a lower-cost generative baseline with the agreed action inputs.
acceptance: Condition on the first frame, selected-object mask, and numeric force.
Define the posterior, prior, reconstruction loss, and KL weight; sample from the prior without future frames at inference.
Pass a tiny-batch overfit check and produce four seeded samples per condition.
Log validation results, model size, training cost, and checkpoint selection.
Add a run manifest and qualitative successes/failures.

title: Implement first-frame and numeric-action diffusion E1/E2
outcome: Create the common diffusion backbone and the main numeric-action baseline.
acceptance: Implement latent video training and sampling with a shared backbone/configuration.
Support first-frame-only E1 and selected-mask-plus-numeric-force E2.
Pass forward/backward, tiny-batch overfit, and checkpoint resume checks.
Measure 64px peak VRAM, seconds/step, and four-sample inference latency.
Record baseline samples and proposed run budgets.

title: Implement object-centric spatial conditioning E3
outcome: Test whether localizing the action improves physical action adherence.
acceptance: Fuse a selected-object feature, numeric force embedding, and spatial action map into the denoiser.
Keep target identification available in E2 so E2-to-E3 isolates the spatial module.
Check selected-object changes, zero/reversed action, and empty or invalid masks with fixed sampling seeds.
Record added parameter count, ablation switch, and working E3 training/sampling.

title: Add trajectory and collision supervision E4
outcome: Test whether physical supervision improves decoded future behavior.
acceptance: Predict trajectories and object-pair collision probabilities from denoiser features.
Define timestep supervision, object-slot matching, valid masks, imbalance handling, and loss weights.
Keep oracle trajectories/collisions/physics out of inference conditioning; any extra object extraction must use first-frame pixels only.
Validate loss gradients and tiny-batch behavior; demonstrate E4 training and sampling.
Report head predictions separately from generated-video tracking metrics.

title: Freeze experiment settings and decide the 128px gate
outcome: Commit to a comparable experiment suite that fits the remaining budget.
acceptance: Freeze dataset versions, model controls, sampler, K, metrics, seeds, and checkpoint criteria.
Use measured costs to allocate training/evaluation hours and retry reserve.
Record a justified proceed/defer decision for 128px; preserve core 64px comparisons.
Record all selected settings and validation-only tuning decisions.
Use independent runs from a common initialization policy for the main diffusion comparisons; report inherited training separately for warm-started runs.

title: Run and analyze the core E0-E4 comparisons
outcome: Produce the main evidence for conditioning and supervision claims.
acceptance: Run the five variants under the frozen protocol and record actual budgets/seed counts.
Compare E2-to-E3 and E3-to-E4 with quality, physical behavior, and cost metrics.
Report mean and best-of-K trajectory scores separately, plus collision prevalence/F1.
Export tables with run IDs, sample counts, group-based uncertainty estimates, and failures.

title: Evaluate held-out shapes, textures, and forces
outcome: Measure which action-conditioned behaviors generalize beyond training.
acceptance: Evaluate separate OOD suites while controlling the other factors.
Use frozen checkpoints and metrics without test-set tuning.
Compare against ID performance and include tracker failure rates.
Save representative successes/failures and state generalization limits.

title: Evaluate hidden-physics uncertainty and action controls
outcome: Distinguish physically meaningful uncertainty from visual noise.
acceptance: Sample K=4 model futures for identical visible conditions and compare with multiple simulator rollouts.
Measure trajectory spread, reference coverage, sample plausibility, and collision-frequency variation.
Evaluate zero force, reversed force, and selected-object changes using the fixed action-control protocol and report stationary/tracking failures.
Present quality/adherence alongside diversity and clearly label single-reference metrics.

title: Build the interactive four-future comparison demo
outcome: Make the model and simulator comparison understandable and repeatable.
acceptance: Support preset scenes and synthetic-domain image input with selected-object masks.
Map drag arrows to the agreed force convention and generate four seeded futures.
Show simulator ground truth only when scene metadata exists.
Label the friction slider as simulator-only for hidden-physics checkpoints.
Add trajectory overlays, loading/error states, and a documented launch path.

title: Prepare the report draft and evidence figures
outcome: Assemble the research narrative while experiments finish.
acceptance: Draft the question, method, and protocol; use docs/REFERENCES.md and compare closely related action-conditioned methods before making novelty claims.
Create table/figure slots tied to E0-E4, OOD, uncertainty, compute, and limitations.
Insert measured findings from T14-T16 as available; mark pending results explicitly.
Collect method and contribution notes from each workstream.

title: Verify reproducibility and freeze the submission artifacts
outcome: Ensure another teammate can reproduce the core workflow and use the final checkpoints.
acceptance: Run a clean-environment setup, simulator replay, checkpoint load, and sampling smoke test.
Verify configs, split hashes, artifact paths/checksums, and actual run commands.
Freeze final tables/figures and record limitations or omitted optional experiments.
Record a backup demo and check the interface on the presentation machine.
Verify that the demo loads the final selected checkpoint and reproduces saved conditions, sampling seeds, and four-future output.

title: Finalize report, slides, and submission package
outcome: Deliver the project against the confirmed course requirements.
acceptance: Finalize conclusions using measured results, include failures and contribution statements.
Complete references, formatting, figures, and presentation rehearsal.
Check required code/checkpoints/report/slides/video artifacts against the official rubric.
Submit by the confirmed 14 November cutoff and record the submission receipt.
